articles.title: Sensex surges over 8,200 pts in Nov. Should you book partial profits & move to safer assets or stay invested?
articles.description: With the BSE Sensex surging significantly in November, investors are contemplating profit booking or continued investment. Experts advise those needing funds soon to shift to safer assets, while long-term investors should stay committed. Recent foreign investments and declining crude oil prices contributed to the market rally. Concerns regarding potential corrections due to rising valuations and inflation are also present.
